clue.text: Like a talented actor with some attractive features

explanation.surface: A description of a gifted performer who also has a few good looks.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who shines in roles is good in parts; the idiom also describes something mixed, with some redeeming qualities.

clue.text: A remarkable person from reading, maybe

parts.note: a, as in a single thing, means one
reading is one of the three Rs of basic schooling (reading, writing, arithmetic), so it stands for R

explanation.surface: Someone exceptional who comes from Reading, the English town.
explanation.walkthrough: Reading looks like the Berkshire town; here it is one of the 'three Rs' (reading, writing, arithmetic), giving R. 'maybe' flags it as one example of the Rs.
explanation.definitionFit: A oner is British slang for an outstanding or unique individual, one of a kind.

clue.text: Welshman's in need of a platform

parts.note: Dai, short for Dafydd, is the stock Welsh man's name in crosswords
the possessive ending gives its letter as written, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A Welsh man is in need of a stage to stand on.
explanation.walkthrough: Dai is the stereotypical Welsh name; the possessive ending supplies the final letter, and the apostrophe vanishes in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised stage at one end of a hall, used by speakers.

clue.text: Want to be given guidance when irritated

parts.note: to want is to need
someone given guidance has been led

explanation.surface: A person who wants direction when they are annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: Needled means provoked or annoyed by persistent jibes.

clue.text: Skills displayed by university faculty

explanation.surface: Abilities on show from a department at a university.
explanation.definitionFit: Arts can mean crafts or knacks, and the Arts is a university division covering humanities subjects.

clue.text: Tutor everyone in the terrace

indicators.note: in puts the word for everyone inside the abbreviation for terrace

parts.note: Ter. is the address abbreviation for terrace
each one, so everyone, is each

explanation.surface: A private tutor addresses everybody in a row of houses or a football stand.
explanation.walkthrough: Ter. is the usual abbreviation for Terrace in street addresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is one who instructs, a schoolmaster or schoolmistress.

clue.text: Cheerful prince is a joker

parts.note: cheerful means merry
Prince Andrew is a member of the British royal family

explanation.surface: A jolly member of the royal family turns out to be a prankster.
explanation.definitionFit: A merry andrew is an old term for a clown or buffoon who entertains with antics.

clue.text: The nature of celebrity

explanation.surface: A reflection on what fame really is.
explanation.definitionFit: Personality means a person's character or makeup, and also a famous figure such as a TV star.

clue.text: Festival makes an utter fortune

indicators.note: to utter is to say out loud, so the word for fortune is heard rather than read

parts.note: fortune, in the sense of destiny, is fate

explanation.surface: A festival brings in a complete fortune for its organisers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utter' looks like an adjective meaning complete, but it is the verb, signalling that the word for fortune is spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: A fete is an outdoor fair or gala, often raising money for charity.

clue.text: Ireland site developed for housing

indicators.note: a site that is developed is built up and changed, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Land in Ireland is built up with homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Residential describes an area or use given over to homes rather than shops or industry.

clue.text: A small room's provided for members

parts.note: rms is the shortened, small form of rooms used in property adverts

explanation.surface: A tiny chamber is set aside for club members.
explanation.walkthrough: Estate agents abbreviate rooms as rms; the apostrophe is surface dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Members are limbs of the body, such as arms and legs.

clue.text: Customise house

explanation.surface: An instruction to adapt a home to suit someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To accommodate is to adapt or adjust something to fit, and also to lodge or provide a roof for someone.

clue.text: Pamela and Cyril produced a medieval drama

indicators.note: produced, as of a stage show, suggests the names are worked into something new

explanation.surface: Two people put on an old religious play together.
explanation.definitionFit: Miracle plays were medieval vernacular dramas showing saints' lives and Bible stories.

clue.text: Ship's barber

explanation.surface: A boat's hairdresser.
explanation.definitionFit: A clipper is a fast sailing vessel, and a clipper is also someone who trims hair.

clue.text: Outfit I had found to be unyielding

parts.note: an outfit or getup is a rig
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: A costume someone owned turned out to be stiff.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigid means stiff and inflexible, refusing to bend.

clue.text: Avoid becoming a burden

explanation.surface: Steering clear of becoming a nuisance to others.
explanation.definitionFit: To refrain is to hold back from doing something; a burden is also a song's recurring chorus.

clue.text: Deny having uprooted an underground stem

indicators.note: in a down clue, pulling something up from the ground turns it upward, reading it from the bottom

parts.note: a tuber is a swollen underground stem, such as a potato

explanation.surface: Refusing to admit having dug up a potato plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprooted' fits the plant picture, but in this down entry it turns the word for an underground stem upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebut is to refute or contradict an accusation.

clue.text: Physician full of wrath appears more fearsome

indicators.note: full of says the word for wrath fills the inside of the abbreviation for physician

parts.note: Dr is the title for a medical doctor
wrath means ire

explanation.surface: An angry doctor looks rather frightening.
explanation.definitionFit: Direr is the comparative of dire, meaning dreadful or terrible.

clue.text: Order given to an Arab sultanate

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A command is issued to a Middle Eastern state.
explanation.definitionFit: Oman is a sultanate on the south-east of the Arabian Peninsula.

clue.text: I act with love initially towards the beloved

parts.note: to act is to do

indicators.note: initially means only the opening letter of love is taken

explanation.surface: A suitor behaves lovingly towards their sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is someone adored or worshipped, a heartthrob.

clue.text: Devout priest and I love America

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
US stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A churchman declares devotion to the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Pious means religious and devoted to worship.

clue.text: Stop prince going to social occasion

parts.note: a social occasion is an event

explanation.surface: Barring a royal from attending a party.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevent is to hinder or keep something from happening.

clue.text: False answer given by witch-doctors

parts.note: something false is a sham

explanation.surface: Medicine men give a fake response.
explanation.definitionFit: Shamans are tribal healers or priests believed to commune with spirits.

clue.text: Mother gets large, fat duck

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
lard is pig fat

explanation.surface: A mother duck grows big and plump.
explanation.definitionFit: The mallard is a common wild duck, the male with a green head.

clue.text: Consequently Estonian leader is in danger

indicators.note: in places the opening letter of Estonian inside the word for danger

parts.note: a danger or menace is a threat

indicators.note: leader means the front letter of Estonian

explanation.surface: As a result, the president of Estonia is at risk.
explanation.definitionFit: Thereat is an archaic adverb meaning as a result of that, or at that point.

clue.text: Only an idiot takes a drug

explanation.surface: Warning that only fools take narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Dope means a stupid person, and also slang for cannabis or any narcotic.

clue.text: Some of the tutorial on Goethe was boring

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a class on the German writer Goethe dragged on.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'was boring' as the definition, but LONG is an adjective that swaps for 'boring', not 'was boring'; 'was' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Long, of a speech or lesson, means tediously lengthy and dull.

clue.text: Restrict river level

parts.note: to tie is to bind or restrict
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Limiting how high a river can rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one row or layer in a stacked series.

clue.text: Record is held in the Washington area

indicators.note: held in means the word is is enclosed by the abbreviation for the district

parts.note: DC is the District of Columbia, the area containing Washington

explanation.surface: A recording is kept in the US capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a vinyl record or CD.

clue.text: I'm amiable or otherwise when viewing souvenirs

indicators.note: otherwise means in another way, so these letters take a different order

explanation.surface: Someone becomes pleasant or not when looking at keepsakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Memorabilia are collectable mementos of people or events.

clue.text: Conveyance going to turkey in the morning

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey
a.m. marks times before noon

explanation.surface: A vehicle taking a turkey somewhere early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turkey' reads as the bird; it is the country, whose car-registration code is TR.
explanation.definitionFit: A tram is a passenger vehicle running on street rails, a means of transport.

clue.text: Longing to act when lorry hounds coaches

indicators.note: hounds means chases or follows behind, so the word for lorry comes after the word for coaches

parts.note: stagecoaches are often just stages
a lorry is a truck

explanation.surface: Wanting to perform while a heavy goods vehicle harasses buses.
explanation.walkthrough: A lorry is British for a truck; coaches here are horse-drawn stagecoaches, or stages.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagestruck describes someone infatuated with the theatre and wishing to perform.
